_about: Borrowed poses: townspeople without an animation (sit, eat, toilet, shower, sleep, the chat gestures) get one built from the closest-looking person who has it, in their own colours and with their own head (urbz_poses.py, made at build time from your game; the first build takes a few minutes). groups: which to make. skip: people (or {person: [groups]}) to leave alone: 47 Lincoln Broadsheet uses a wheelchair, so no sitting down on things, toilet or shower; he eats in his chair (urbz_poses.WHEELCHAIR). 62 Mokey: the game draws him its own way (entity +0xC0 bit 0x80, not in his own colours) and his animation doesn't change his picture, so borrowed poses wouldn't show; he is left out.
